_about: The Sorting Hat's question bank. Every answer gives points to one or more houses. Edit freely: add questions, change the points, or translate them. House names must be exactly Gryffindor, Hufflepuff, Ravenclaw or Slytherin, and every id must be different.

questions.text: It's Halloween, and a troll is loose in the castle. You realise a classmate is alone in the girls' bathroom and has no idea. What do you do?

options.text: Run to find them right now. There's no time to fetch a teacher.
Grab a friend and go together. Nobody should face a troll alone.
Remember what you've read about trolls and set a clever trap.
Alert a teacher, and make sure everyone knows it was you who raised the alarm.

questions.text: You find the Mirror of Erised, which shows your heart's deepest desire. What do you see?

options.text: Me, back from a great adventure, with my friends cheering.
Everyone I love, together, safe and happy.
Me, holding the answer to a question nobody has ever solved.
Me, powerful and admired, my name known everywhere.

questions.text: A rival challenges you to a secret wizard's duel at midnight in the trophy room. You...

options.text: Show up, wand ready. I never back down from a challenge.
Show up, but bring a friend and insist it's a fair fight.
Smell a trap and stay in bed.
Agree... then tip off the caretaker, so it's my rival who gets caught.

questions.text: Would you put your name into the Goblet of Fire?

options.text: Instantly. Eternal glory!
Only to make my house proud, and I'd help the other champions too.
Not before studying every task from every past tournament.
Yes. The prize money and the fame would open a lot of doors.

questions.text: You find the Restricted Section of the library unlocked at night. You...

options.text: Sneak in. Some rules are worth breaking for an adventure.
Lock it and tell the librarian, so nobody gets into trouble.
Go in, but only for that one book I've been dying to read.
Look for anything that could give me an edge, and make sure nobody sees me.

questions.text: Your house is losing the Quidditch final and you're on the team. You...

options.text: Go for a wild, risky dive at the Snitch.
Keep cheering on my teammates and play fair to the very end.
Spot the pattern in the other team's moves and call a smarter play.
Rattle their Seeker. It's not technically against the rules...

questions.text: Which of the Deathly Hallows would you choose?

options.text: The Invisibility Cloak, for secret adventures.
The Resurrection Stone, to see the people I've lost.
None of them. I'd rather find out how they were made.
The Elder Wand, the most powerful wand ever made.

questions.text: Which spell would you want to master first?

options.text: Expelliarmus, so I can protect anyone, anywhere.
A healing charm, so I can patch up my friends.
A brand-new spell that I invent myself.
Legilimency, so I always know what others are thinking.

questions.text: A boggart turns into the thing you fear most. What does yours become?

options.text: Me, frozen and useless while my friends are in danger.
Me, all alone, because my friends have turned their backs on me.
A pile of exam papers, all marked 'FAIL'.
Me, forgotten: a nobody who never achieved anything.

questions.text: The Room of Requirement opens up just for you. What's inside?

options.text: A duelling hall, to train for real danger.
A cosy common room where everyone is welcome.
An endless library with the comfiest armchair in the castle.
A hidden vault full of forgotten secrets and powerful objects.

questions.text: You have a free afternoon in Hogsmeade. Where do you go?

options.text: Up to the Shrieking Shack. They say it's haunted!
The Three Broomsticks, with as many friends as fit around the table.
The bookshop, then a quiet corner to read what I bought.
Wherever the important people are. It's all about who you know.

questions.text: Your group reaches a door sealed by a tricky magical riddle. What's your role?

options.text: Leading the way into whatever is behind it.
Keeping everyone calm and making sure nobody gets left behind.
Solving the riddle while everyone else panics.
Making the plan, and making sure it works out best for me.

questions.text: A friend broke a school rule, and a teacher asks you who did it. You...

options.text: Take the blame myself to protect them.
Say nothing. I'd never betray a friend.
Explain, very logically, why it wasn't really against the rules.
Keep quiet, and remind my friend later that they owe me one.

questions.text: What do you think about school rules?

options.text: Made to be broken when something important is at stake.
They keep everyone safe and treated fairly, so I follow them.
Fine, as long as someone can explain why they exist.
Useful, mostly for the people who know how to bend them.

questions.text: What would you like to do after Hogwarts?

options.text: Become an Auror and hunt down dark wizards.
Be a Healer at St Mungo's, or a teacher.
Study the secrets of magic in the Department of Mysteries.
Climb all the way up to Minister for Magic.

questions.text: What would you keep in your vault at Gringotts?

options.text: A trophy from the bravest thing I've ever done.
Letters and photos from the people I love.
My notebooks, full of ideas and inventions.
Gold (lots of it) and a few valuable secrets.

questions.text: You may look after one magical creature for a year. Which one?

options.text: A hippogriff: proud, fierce and amazing to fly.
A family of Bowtruckles: small, loyal and devoted to their tree.
A Demiguise: it can turn invisible and see the future.
A snake: clever, elegant and badly misunderstood.

questions.text: Professor Slughorn will give a bottle of Felix Felicis to whoever brews the best potion. How do you win it?

options.text: Trust my instincts and go for it boldly.
Follow the instructions patiently, step by careful step.
Find a cleverer method than the one in the textbook.
Charm the professor. He loves collecting talented students.
